skill.name: shadcn
skill.description: Helps AI agents build and maintain shadcn/ui projects with CLI-aware workflows, component rules, styling guidance, registry usage, presets, and chat UI patterns.
skill.summary: Guides shadcn/ui component work with CLI context, registry commands, and design-system rules.
skill.author: shadcn

security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are false positives from Markdown examples, TSX template literals, relative documentation links, UI validation attributes, and PNG assets. Confirmed risk remains the intended use of npx shadcn@latest and remote or community registries, which can fetch packages, access network resources, and modify project files. No evidence found of prompt injection, credential exfiltration, or malicious hidden behavior.

remediation.suggestion: Pin the shadcn CLI version or require explicit user confirmation before the first package-runner command in each project.
Require an explicit registry source, preview with dry-run or view, and review added files before installation.
Warn users before adding components or presets from arbitrary URLs, even when dry-run is used.

content.user_title: Build shadcn UI with Project-Aware Guidance
content.value_statement: Teams often lose time matching shadcn/ui APIs, presets, and project conventions. This skill guides component selection, CLI usage, styling, registry workflows, and safe update previews.
actual_capabilities: Reads shadcn project context through the CLI and uses aliases, framework, Tailwind version, and installed components.
Guides component selection for forms, navigation, overlays, feedback, chat, tables, charts, and empty states.
Explains shadcn CLI workflows for init, add, apply, search, docs, dry-run, diff, and view.
Applies styling rules for semantic colors, layout gaps, variants, icons, dark mode, and conditional classes.
Documents registry, preset, MCP, and customization workflows for shadcn projects.
limitations: Requires a project that uses shadcn/ui or plans to add it.
May run package-manager commands that require network access and user approval.
Does not replace manual review of third-party registry code before installation.
Cannot guarantee compatibility with future shadcn CLI releases.

use_cases.title: Build Consistent Interfaces
use_cases.description: Create forms, dashboards, navigation, and chat views that follow shadcn/ui composition and styling rules.

use_cases.title: Maintain Component Updates
use_cases.description: Preview upstream changes with dry-run and diff workflows before merging them into customized components.

use_cases.title: Configure Registry Workflows
use_cases.description: Use shadcn registries, presets, and MCP guidance for project-aware assistant workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Form
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a shadcn/ui settings form with FieldGroup, Field, semantic colors, accessible validation, and project-aware imports.

prompt_templates.title: Add Components Safely
prompt_templates.prompt: Check whether button, dialog, and table are installed. Use dry-run or diff before adding missing shadcn components.

prompt_templates.title: Update Local Components
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare my installed shadcn button and input components with upstream. Preserve local changes and explain each file update.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Registry Block
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect a requested community registry block before installation. Verify imports, dependencies, composition rules, icon library, and unsafe code risks.

output_examples.input: Create a profile settings form with validation and notification controls.
output_examples.output: A component plan using FieldGroup, Field, Input, ToggleGroup, semantic colors, accessible labels, and project-aware imports.

output_examples.input: Update my sidebar without losing local edits.
output_examples.output: A dry-run and diff workflow that lists affected files, preserves local edits, and asks before overwrites.

output_examples.input: Add a chat transcript view to my app.
output_examples.output: A chat UI plan using MessageScroller, Message, Bubble, Attachment, and Marker with streaming handled by primitives.

best_practices: Run dry-run and diff before installing or updating components.
Use project context for aliases, Tailwind version, icon library, framework, and existing components.
Review third-party registry files before merging them into the project.
anti_patterns: Installing registry items without a named registry or user confirmation.
Overwriting local components before reviewing diffs.
Hardcoding imports, raw colors, icon sizes, or dark-mode overrides.

faq.question: Does this skill install components automatically?
faq.answer: It can guide CLI commands, but user approval should be required before commands that change files.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: It supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it work outside shadcn/ui projects?
faq.answer: It is most useful in projects with components.json or plans to initialize shadcn/ui.

faq.question: Can it handle community registries?
faq.answer: Yes. It can search and add registry items, but third-party code should be reviewed first.

faq.question: Can it update customized components?
faq.answer: Yes. It recommends dry-run and diff workflows to merge upstream changes while preserving local edits.

faq.question: Does it cover styling rules?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers semantic tokens, variants, spacing, icons, conditional classes, and dark-mode conventions.
